cands.name: Nick Pachota
cands.bio: Republican; Venice Mayor (council since 2019, vice mayor, mayor since 2022); former EMT, paramedic, firefighter and SWAT medic and current EMS instructor for Sarasota County Schools; co-owner of Venice Pier Group (Sharky's on the Pier).
cands.local_ties: Moved to Venice in 1987; attended local schools (Florida Politics).

record.text: Venice City Council since 2019, Vice Mayor, then Mayor from 2022. Campaign cites tax cuts in Venice and opposing growth that overwhelms existing communities.

money_notes.text: Through July 31 he and his committee Friends of Nick Pachota raised about $327,000 plus a $100,000 candidate loan. In one June report, $1,000 each came from Safety Net Hospital Alliance of Florida and Committee of Safety Net Hospitals, and $500 each from Jesse Biter and Associated Industries of Florida.
